item_name: Rothco Hanging Roll-Up Morale Patch Board
item_short_desc: Rothco's Hanging Roll-Up Morale Patch Board is the ultimate solution for organizing and displaying your morale patches. Crafted from durable 600D polyester, this collectors board is lightweight, making it easy to carry and store. Measuring 24 inch x 18.5 inch, the board provides ample space to showcase your favorite patches. The roll-up design ensures maximum portability, and a convenient hook & loop strip secures the display board when rolled up, keeping your patches safe during transport. Please note, patches are not included.
